title: Pyramid sarcophagi too big for the entrance, so placed while the chamber was built

tellings.quote: And the sarcophagi are too big for the entrance way. So they're not brought in later. They were placed in the room while the room was created.

plain: The stone coffins inside the Great Pyramid at Giza are said to be too big to fit through the entrance, so they could not have been carried in later and must have been put in place while the room itself was being built. A researcher named Luke Caverns says this, without naming a source, as a sign that the pyramid's builders planned the chambers around them from the start.
